text:
Coordinator: Aurelia Skyways training update for the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
Planner: Safety leads every move for Milo and all traveler luggage.
Ops Lead: Crews follow the posted handling notes; speed never overrides safety.
Travel Desk: Care plans match species, temperament, and comfort, then get checked before boarding.
Routines: Watch the pet lounge flow and keep transitions calm.
Gate Liaison: Caldreth is the pet lounge operator who manages the space; Elara Voss runs it.
Service Coach: Verify equipment, confirm transport surfaces are clean, and monitor stress signs.
Duty Editor: Staff log each step clearly so handoffs stay consistent.
Crew Trainer: Maintain quiet voice levels, avoid sudden movements, and support hydration plans.
Coordinator: Close the loop by filing the final status so the next crew can repeat the exact care plan.
